criterion.name: Horizontal rotation (360° orbit)
criterion.requirement: Dragging left/right rotates the camera around the cube horizontally
Full 360° rotation allowed (no horizontal limits)
Rotation is smooth and responsive (< 16ms input lag)
Works with mouse drag on desktop

criterion.name: Vertical rotation (limited arc)
criterion.requirement: Dragging up/down rotates the camera vertically
Limited to prevent flipping over the cube (minPolarAngle/maxPolarAngle)
Cannot see the bottom of the cube (contact shadow remains grounded)
Reasonable vertical range: ~15° to ~85° from vertical axis

criterion.name: Zoom in/out functionality
criterion.requirement: Scroll wheel zooms on desktop
Pinch gesture zooms on mobile/touch devices
Sensible zoom limits (minDistance/maxDistance)
Cube should not clip through camera (min zoom)
Cube should remain visible and detailed at max zoom out

criterion.name: Reset view to default position
criterion.requirement: Double-click (desktop) or double-tap (mobile) resets camera to default angle
Reset animates smoothly to default position
Default position: same as initial load (front-facing, slightly elevated)

criterion.name: Auto-rotate when idle (optional, stoppable)
criterion.requirement: Cube slowly auto-rotates when user is not interacting
Auto-rotation pauses immediately on any user interaction
Auto-rotation resumes after ~3 seconds of inactivity
Rotation speed is subtle and elegant (not distracting)

criterion.name: Touch gesture support
criterion.requirement: Single finger drag rotates the cube (same as mouse drag)
Pinch zooms in/out
Double-tap resets view
All gestures feel natural on mobile devices
No conflicts with scrolling the page

criterion.name: Panning disabled
criterion.requirement: Pan/translation is disabled (cube stays centered)
Right-click drag does not pan
Two-finger drag (non-pinch) does not pan

criterion.name: Visual interaction hint for first-time users
criterion.requirement: On first visit to configurator, display hint: "Drag to rotate"
Hint fades out after user's first interaction or after 3 seconds
Hint stored in localStorage to not show again
Hint is accessible (aria-label)

criterion.name: Performance maintained
criterion.requirement: Interactions at 60fps (NFR2)
No jank or stuttering during rotation
frameloop="demand" still works (re-renders on interaction)
Input lag < 16ms for responsive feel

  maxPolarAngle={number}

/>

constraint.rule: UI overlays like InteractionHint in src/components/configurator/
frameloop="demand" must continue working - OrbitControls triggers invalidate automatically
Component Pattern: Hooks first, derived state, event handlers, render
Use Zustand selectors (useConfigStore) for state access
Dynamic import with ssr: false for 3D components
Hint must have aria-label for screen readers

tests.standards: Testing follows Next.js 15 conventions. Unit tests with Vitest for utilities and hooks. Component tests with @testing-library/react for React components. E2E tests with Playwright for user flows. 3D components tested via integration (canvas interactions harder to unit test).
